title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Training Note: Automatic-Refill Credit Against Installment Late Charges
content:
## Training note: automatic refills and installment late charges

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, an automatic-refill credit is then taken off the waived late charge: 0.50 when the member is enrolled in automatic refills and two or more automatic refill orders were placed less than 12 whole months before the handling date, 0.25 when the member is enrolled with exactly one such order, and nothing in every other case; the late charge never falls below zero.

### Questions answered

**What is it taken off?** The late charge as it stands after any waived part has been taken off it.

**What shows enrollment?** The automatic refill enrollment recorded on the home delivery account. Automatic refill orders are placed orders whose origin is an automatic refill.

**Can the credit turn the late charge negative?** No; the late charge never falls below zero.

### Credit table

| Enrolled in automatic refills | Automatic refill orders placed less than 12 whole months before the handling date | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | 0.50 |
| Yes | exactly 1 | 0.25 |
| Yes | none | nothing |
| No | any | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

- Waived late charge of 2.50, enrolled, three automatic refill orders: 2.50 less 0.50, 2.00.
- Late charge of nothing, enrolled, two automatic refill orders: stays at zero.
